patch.value: Successful linked-test receipts carry non-actionable execution_context and all-zero failure_categories, even under --lean

Found while delivering pm-gh1630. After a selective run's tests[] was bounded to the selected entries, the remaining cost of a successful pm test --run receipt is mostly constant plumbing. On a 1-test --only-last run that passed: default TOON 2198 bytes, --lean 2178, --json 2685, --lean --json 2645. Every variant contains the full execution_context block (about 1.2 KB): requested and actual pm_context_mode, source and sandbox project and global paths, item counts, extension seeding flags, workspace roots and the trust fingerprint. It also contains a 9-row failure_categories map of zeros. When the run passed and mismatch_detected is false, an agent cannot act on any of it.

pm-fqdmbf (closed) hoisted the execution context to once per invocation and made --lean drop successful empty streams. Its acceptance criterion 'Lean structured output omits non-actionable successful-run sandbox plumbing while failures retain enough provenance' was delivered for streams only. This item covers the remaining boundary: what a successful, mismatch-free receipt must say about its sandbox, and whether all-zero failure categories need to be printed at all.

Measure the default, lean and JSON receipts for passing and failing runs, with and without a context mismatch; Define which execution_context fields are actionable on success and project the rest behind an explicit restore path, keeping full provenance on failure, refusal or mismatch; Render failure_categories compactly when every count is zero, without losing the counts on failure; Keep CLI, SDK and MCP shapes consistent and record the measured byte reduction

A passing, mismatch-free linked-test receipt omits non-actionable sandbox plumbing and zero-count categories by default or under --lean, with a documented way to restore them; failures keep full diagnostic provenance.

value.text: Duplicate check: a semantic search for execution_context and linked-test receipt verbosity, and a keyword search for execution_context. Closed pm-fqdmbf is the nearest owner. Its resolution records hoisting plus lean removal of successful streams only, and the live CLI shows execution_context in every variant, so this is a distinct, still-open boundary rather than a recurrence. Measured on this branch (feat/agent-same-command-corrections) in an isolated tracker.
